short: Lower and upper bounds for lattice slopes

lean.name: Formalism.RankGapBounds.WeightedMeanData.Data.Slopes
lean.plain: Lower and upper bounds for lattice slopes
lean.note: The lower bound on the average slope of $M_u$ limits how much the starting lattice can cost in the gain inequality. The upper bound on its maximal slope separately controls the highest part of its Harder–Narasimhan filtration.
